samples.xml_description:
<module id="ROM">
    <description>A Read-Only Memory (ROM) module designed for storing fixed data. This module provides a way to access predefined data based on an 8-bit address input.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="addr" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit address input used to select the data location in memory.</input>
        <output id="dout" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit output that delivers the data stored in the ROM at the specified address.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Reads data from the ROM based on the address input.</implementation>
</module>
